title: Return story work for revision without losing history
description:
# Return story work for revision without losing history

## Intent

As an editor, I want to return a story to an earlier editorial stage, so that revision is represented honestly instead of being performed behind an unchanged status.

## Behavior specification

Feature: Revise newsroom story work

Scenario: Return reporting for more research
  Given a story has reached reporting or editor selection
  When the editor requests additional research through a supported transition
  Then the story returns to the configured research stage
  And existing assignment, research, and report artifacts remain available
  And guidance explains what must change before reporting can advance again

Scenario: Return reader-facing copy for revision
  Given a story has reached copywriting
  When the editor requests copy revision through a supported transition
  Then the story remains in or returns to the configured copywriting stage
  And the prior article artifact remains in Git history
  And publication remains unavailable until the revised copy passes its gate

## Boundary

Slice 1 needs only the return paths exercised by the real story. It does not need a hosted assignment-event model or verified editor identity.
